column4: Auto follows directory existence; persistent still has early-boot/unwritable fallback; namespace directory creation qualification retained in source.
10% MaxUse and 15% KeepFree defaults each capped at 4G; both limits apply subject to startup and archived-file qualifications.
LESS_BY(free,keep_free) is saturated subtraction, not smaller-of/free minimum; min_use also qualifies unconditional respect of KeepFree.
Startup patch and restart-reset statement match comment; MAX preserves an existing larger minimum; full rotation also calls patch_min_use.
One-eighth default capped 128M; seven rotated files is explicitly usual, not guaranteed; compact-mode maximum capped 4G.
Default 100; archived-only deletion means active journals can leave total above limit after vacuum.
All four macro values hold; only rate pair assigned in journal_config_set_defaults; sync and max-file defaults applied in manager_merge_configs.
Oldest archived vacuum-size removal and active-inclusive disk usage hold; rotate first makes active data eligible.
